LOCK EXPIRED
T=12.5s Lock expires (no renewal after failure)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Timeline comparison:
Without renewal (TTL=9s):
Acquire ──[ process for 12s ]── Lock expires at T=9s
─── Crash: lock released at T=9s
With renewal (TTL=9s, interval=3s):
Acquire ──[ process for 12s ]── Lock held entire 12s
─── Crash: lock released at T_last_renewal + 9s
